reason: When I go out I already know the venue, so I just pay at the door or WhatsApp them, and that costs me nothing extra. I'm not going to download another app and pay R8 a time for something I can do free, and then pay R5 more to get the ticket on WhatsApp.
objection: It's a fee on top of a fee to do what I already do for free, and it's one more app taking up data for something I only book a few times a month.
would_change_my_mind: No booking fee, or an event that sells out and that I can only get through TROVE, or a real discount on the ticket that covers more than the fee.
